{{Quote|Capperling's Cantina in Dankcamp Village. ''[&hellip;]'' You need directions?''"<br />"''We can find it. ''[&hellip;]'' How soon do you need someone?|Rebel operatives Han Solo and Leia Organa|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''Dankcamp Village''' was a [[City/Legends|settlement]] located on the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Poln Minor]] that was populated by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], wanted [[Gangster/Legends|thugs]], and their servants. It contained [[Capperling's Cantina]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] visited Capperling's [[Cantina/Legends|Cantina]], where the<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> leader of the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] force named [[Ranquiv]] hired the pair to arm [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Whisperlike fighter]]s with [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile]]s.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dankcamp Village appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
